name: Hailuo AI
summary: MiniMax's AI video and image generator.
description: Hailuo AI, from MiniMax, generates videos and images from text prompts or photos and includes meme and effect tools aimed at social content. It is known for expressive motion at competitive prices. A free plan lets users generate with limited credits, and paid subscriptions add more credits, faster queues and higher quality outputs.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: A free plan lets users generate with limited credits, and paid subscriptions add more credits, faster queues and higher quality outputs.

howToUse.title: Choose video or image
howToUse.description: The homepage has Create Video and Create Image, plus Hailuo Agent.

howToUse.title: Describe what you want
howToUse.description: The video field asks you to describe the content. Its example is a child flying a kite in a park, with golden sunlight and the camera tilting up.

howToUse.title: Set references and format
howToUse.description: The composer shows a reference slot, a model choice, a duration, and an aspect ratio. MiniMax H3 is the model marked live on the page.

howToUse.title: Create
howToUse.description: Press Create. The page also links MiniMax H3 tutorials for open-weight projects and workflows.
